title: Corpus of Chinese Dynastic Histories: Gender Analysis over Two Millennia
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation of a historical Chinese corpus and a linguistic analysis of gendered terms (male vs. female). While it identifies terms related to social roles and Confucian values (like 'filial piety') as part of its topic modeling results, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
